title: Supplier sample review procedure
summary: A repeatable demonstration process for inspecting, documenting and responding to a supplier sample.
contentNotice: Demonstration content for Atlas interface development; not final MOSCATELLI policy.

blocks.text: Record when the sample arrived and identify the specification, quotation or previous sample against which it should be reviewed.

items: Relevant specification or previous reference is available
Packaging and transit condition are recorded before disposal

steps.title: Inspect objectively
steps.text: Check dimensions, materials, construction, finish and any agreed measurable requirements.

steps.title: Photograph evidence
steps.text: Capture both the overall sample and details that explain any deviation or requested revision.

steps.title: Separate fact from preference
steps.text: Distinguish specification failures from creative refinements so the supplier can understand the priority.

steps.title: Consolidate feedback
steps.text: Send one coherent revision request rather than fragmented comments from multiple channels.

blocks.label: Useful distinction
blocks.text: A defect is not the same as a design change. Recording the distinction improves supplier accountability and preserves a clearer development history.

items: Critical: prevents approval or safe use
Material: meaningful deviation from specification or intended quality
Minor: acceptable for the stage but worth monitoring
Creative revision: requested change rather than supplier non-conformity

blocks.text: Record the outcome, the requested next sample or action, and any agreed timing. Keep the evidence with the development record so the next review can compare like with like.
